calculate_miou: calculate the mean Intersection over Union score between predicted and ground truth binary tensors
calculate_miou_batch: calculate the mean IoU across a batch of predicted and ground truth tensors
calculate_miou_segmentation: calculate the mIoU metric for binary segmentation predictions using PyTorch tensors
test_calculate_miou: test the calculate_miou function with matching shape predicted and ground truth tensors
refactor_calculate_miou: refactor the calculate_miou function to support multi-class IoU instead of binary only
